claim_title: RR beats refusal + adv baselines on unseen-attack ASR + preserves capability

figures.caption: HarmBench per-category ASR by model variant (30 prompts / category). Iter-5 RR (signed_hinge + refuse-CE) achieves 0.000 across all 6 attack categories (matching B1's over-refusal ceiling) while B0 sits at aggregate 0.333 and the original cos²-loss RR sits at 0.356 (slightly worse than B0).

Capability preservation on MT-Bench (out of 10) and MMLU (5-shot accuracy). Iter-5 RR = 6.15 / 0.56 stays within plan tolerance vs B0 = 6.30 / 0.58; B1 collapses to 1.08 MT-Bench (over-refusal), confirming its 0-ASR is not a safety win but a capability collapse.
